original_finding.title: Local promotion replay calls forbidden legacy UTC accessors
original_finding.trigger: Decode a four-field local bootstrap history through PROMOTE with request.payload.original tagged visual.owner.original.local.v1, matching contract/source/role/proposal/requirements and preceding capture/plan state.
original_finding.evidence: The exact tag dispatch in visual_owner.py:127–128 returns LocalVisualOriginalPlan. _history dispatches through _replay_bootstrap at 1288–1327; that replay decodes prior at 950 and passes it into _bootstrap_promotion_source at 990. With earlier source predicates satisfied, the helper evaluates prior.registered_at at 854–855 and prior.effective_deadline_at at 856. owner_registration.py:548–553 routes both properties to legacy_deadline(); local_temporal.py:1876–1877 always raises ValueError.
original_finding.consequence: A fully local promoted-original history cannot complete this validation path. It is forced through an archival UTC relation that the local type intentionally forbids. Separately decodable promotion requests do not prove full history restoration.
original_finding.remedy: Use explicitly tagged local-versus-archival promotion source validation. Preserve external timestamp bytes and archival checks, but derive local relations from immutable descriptors/provenance without UTC authority getters. Validate a complete local-original capture/plan/promotion history and a separate preserved legacy-original control.
original_finding.scope: Residual I1/full-history replay defect. No live permission bypass claimed.
original_finding.verification: Static call/type-path deduction only. Actual positive new-style history cases stop at bootstrap capture or supervision wait completion; no full local-original PROMOTE history was executed.

resolved.resolution: Exact LocalVisualOriginalPlan branch skips only the archival UTC timestamp getters. Frame/episode, compiler inventory, policy, dependency, camera and retry-source checks remain. Complete five-event local PROMOTE replay now succeeds; preserved legacy replay succeeds; internally valid compiler-policy and original-time mutations are rejected.
resolved.actual_tests: RED local UTC getter failure and legacy PASS; GREEN both complete histories PASS plus two source-negative cases.

original_finding.title: Embedded local original plans are not joined to the enclosing complete original_time
original_finding.trigger: Use a valid visual.owner.original.local.v1 child whose original_time differs only in a valid verification_reference.window_id. Keep lease identity, sources and contract content equal. Embed it as payload.original in a local route input, update the sibling publication original_plan_hash to the child digest and recompute publication_hash, but retain the enclosing original_time for publication and budgets. Supervision original edges use the same incomplete check.
original_finding.evidence: _join_audit_original at 614–625 compares lease/fence identity, sources and contract hash, never LocalVisualOriginalPlan.local_time. Route input calls it at 1538–1540 and supervision at 1435–1437. _audit_publication checks the publication own time at 475–480 and its identity/hash relation to prior at 556–557. Recursive validation at 433–445 validates child internal consistency but cannot replace the missing parent equality. The four R182 joins do not cover payload.original.
original_finding.consequence: A decoded request can combine a locally tagged original plan from one original-time history with a publication, budgets and outer history bound to another. Identity/source equality is weaker than exact original-obligation continuity.
original_finding.remedy: For this declared semantic original-plan edge, compare local prior.local_time exactly with the enclosing original. Retain separate legacy archival checks and independently valid originals in descriptive JSON. Add an independently valid alternate-child negative case with refreshed sibling hashes.
original_finding.scope: Residual immutable-original causality gap adjacent to I4; the original four budget mismatch cases are fixed.
original_finding.verification: Static counterexample construction, not executed. This concerns payload.original, not the deliberately permitted independent descriptive child parameter.

resolved.resolution: Semantic original-plan edges compare the full local prior.local_time payload to enclosing original_time. This is scoped to declared joins and retains independently valid descriptive JSON children. Route input and both supervision joins reject an independently accepted alternate original after dependent publication hashes are refreshed.
resolved.actual_tests: All three RED cases wrongly returned; all three GREEN parent joins reject while baseline, alternate original and coherent publication independently return.

original_finding.title: Route budget tasks are compared only with each other
original_finding.trigger: Starting from the accepted fully nested local route fixture, change both before_verification_budget.payload.task_id and after_verification_budget.payload.task_id to the same different nonempty task. Recompute each budget content_hash from its schema/task/state/revision. Leave original_time, revisions and counters unchanged, and leave route input and produced publication unchanged.
original_finding.evidence: _audit_pool at 598–611 checks envelope and enclosing original_time. Budget validation at 1608–1611 checks task/content hash without an original-plan task join. Route 1585–1598 checks before_task == after_task, revision +1 and nonincreasing counters/limits, not equality with input original task. Input/source hashes do not cover these separate before/after fields. Produced publication at 1599–1602 is validated independently and checked only against its declared publication hash.
original_finding.consequence: A route for task A can be accepted with a declared budget debit for task B, despite valid time envelopes. The history does not establish the task-bound transition it claims.
original_finding.remedy: Join before/after task identities to the exact decoded input original and enforce the applicable input/publication-budget and produced-publication-budget relations. Add the paired task-id mutation with recomputed content hashes.
original_finding.scope: T1 detached route causal audit only, not evidence of actual CAS or live budget mutation.
original_finding.verification: Static control-flow deduction from the accepted fixture structure; no probe was run.

resolved.resolution: Route extracts the exact input original and joins both budget task IDs to its identity.task_id. Produced publication is audited with that original; existing publication validation binds identity, original digest, contract digest, checkpoint and both budget tasks. Revision/no-refund checks remain; no unsupported whole-budget equality across revisions is introduced.
resolved.actual_tests: RED accepted local paired-task, legacy paired-task and coherent foreign-publication mutations; GREEN rejects all three, with valid local/legacy route controls.
